physics-killer-02.title: Ọrụ na mgbanwe ume mechanical
physics-killer-02.goal: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.
physics-killer-02.material: Site n'ala ụzọ na-enweghị esemokwu (ịdị elu $0$) a jikọtara okirikiri kwụ ọtọ (loop) nwere radius $R=4\,\mathrm{m}$. A chọrọ ịhapụ ihe dị $2\,\mathrm{kg}$ site n'izu ike n'ụzọ ka ọ gaa gburugburu loop otu ugboro. Ọ bụrụ na $g=10\,\mathrm{m/s^2}$, kedu nhọrọ na-ejikọta nke ọma, n'usoro, ịdị elu mmalite kacha ala $h_{min}$ (site n'ala) iji gafee elu loop na-ahapụghị ụzọ, na ike kwụ ọtọ $N$ ụzọ na-etinye n'ihe n'elu mgbe ịdị elu mmalite bụ $15\,\mathrm{m}$?
physics-killer-02.s.s1.prompt: Site n'ala ụzọ na-enweghị esemokwu (ịdị elu $0$) a jikọtara okirikiri kwụ ọtọ (loop) nwere radius $R=4\,\mathrm{m}$. A chọrọ ịhapụ ihe dị $2\,\mathrm{kg}$ site n'izu ike n'ụzọ ka ọ gaa gburugburu loop otu ugboro. Ọ bụrụ na $g=10\,\mathrm{m/s^2}$, kedu nhọrọ na-ejikọta nke ọma, n'usoro, ịdị elu mmalite kacha ala $h_{min}$ (site n'ala) iji gafee elu loop na-ahapụghị ụzọ, na ike kwụ ọtọ $N$ ụzọ na-etinye n'ihe n'elu mgbe ịdị elu mmalite bụ $15\,\mathrm{m}$?
physics-killer-02.s.s1.explain: Ọnọdụ kacha ala $N=0$: $mg=mv^2/R\Rightarrow v_{top}^2=gR=40$. Site na nchekwa ume $mgh_{min}=mg(2R)+\frac12mv_{top}^2$, $h_{min}=2R+\dfrac{R}{2}=2.5R=10\,\mathrm{m}$. Mgbe $h=15\,\mathrm{m}$, $v_{top}^2=2g(h-2R)=2\cdot10\cdot7=140$. Site na $mg+N=mv^2/R$, $N=m\left(\dfrac{v^2}{R}-g\right)=2(35-10)=50\,\mathrm{N}$. Iji naanị ịdị elu $2R=8\,\mathrm{m}$ pụtara na e hapụrụ ume mmegharị (azịza na-ezighị ezi ①); $N=mv^2/R=70\,\mathrm{N}$ pụtara na e leghaara ike ndọda anya (azịza na-ezighị ezi ②); $90\,\mathrm{N}$ bụ njehie akara nke ịgbakwunye ike ndọda (azịza na-ezighị ezi ③).
physics-killer-02.s.s2.prompt: Which scenario demonstrates the correct real-world application of this principle?
physics-killer-02.s.s2.explain: The fundamental principles of this inquiry are widely implemented in modern technology.
physics-killer-02.s.s1.hint.0: N'elu $mg+N=\dfrac{mv^2}{R}$, ọnọdụ ịghara ịhapụ ụzọ bụ $N\ge0$, ya bụ $v_{top}\ge\sqrt{gR}$. Site na nchekwa ume $mgh=mg(2R)+\frac12mv_{top}^2$.
physics-killer-02.s.s1.hint.1: Ebe $v_{top}^2=gR=40$, $h_{min}=2R+\dfrac{v_{top}^2}{2g}=8+2=10\,\mathrm{m}$. Ọ bụrụ na $h=15\,\mathrm{m}$ mgbe ahụ $v_{top}^2=2\cdot10\cdot(15-8)=140$.
